changes_from_previous: Brings validate_state() and _check_issues() into full compliance with schemas/state-v2.schema.json and schemas/check-v2.schema.json. A systematic field-by-field audit of both schemas against the Python validators found 12 places where an input the schema declares invalid was silently accepted: (1) project_id only checked the PROJECT- prefix, not the full ^PROJECT-[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ pattern; (2) the state object accepted arbitrary unexpected top-level fields despite additionalProperties: false; (3) the checks container accepted extra keys beyond 'current'; (4) the operations container accepted extra keys beyond 'open'; (5) the optional state-level 'extensions' and 'legacy' fields were never type-checked; (6) a check's id only checked the CHK- prefix, not the full pattern; (7) requirement_ids/task_ids items were not checked against their REQ-/TASK- patterns; (8) requirement_ids/task_ids/input_paths/evidence_refs/invalidated_by allowed duplicate items despite uniqueItems; (9) input_paths/evidence_refs/invalidated_by allowed empty-string items despite minLength 1; (10) environment accepted non-scalar values despite the schema restricting values to string/number/boolean/null; (11) a check-level 'extensions' of the wrong type was accepted; (12) a check accepted arbitrary unexpected fields despite additionalProperties: false. A second-pass review (Codex) also found that wrongly-typed values such as a list or object in 'stage', 'depth', 'result_status', a check or operation 'status', an operation 'task_id', or a requirement_ids/task_ids item crashed the validator with TypeError (unhashable type used in a set membership test) instead of producing a validation issue; all of these now report an issue, and requirement/task membership is only checked for items that already match their ID pattern. Each gap was reproduced against the pre-fix code and confirmed fixed afterward. 20 new regression tests cover these cases, including a CLI test that invalid writes return JSON and leave state and history unchanged. No SKILL.md change.
